_about: Manual review of every conflict finding reported by /compare on day 1 (2026-11-06). Each finding was checked by opening both source locations at the pinned commits (docsdrift/targets.py) and, where possible, the project's source code. label: true = real contradiction, false = not a contradiction, uncertain = could not decide.

main_pipeline.label: true
main_pipeline.reason: Server.md lists required custom-logger methods info,error,debug,fatal,warn,trace,child. Logging.md additionally requires `silent` and a `level` property. lib/logger-factory.js:68 validates only info,error,debug,fatal,warn,trace,child.

main_pipeline.label: true
main_pipeline.reason: TypeScript.md says request.body is always null in preParsing; Hooks.md says always undefined. lib/request.js:40 sets this.body = undefined. The B quote returned by the API is wide (lines 80-110) but contains the conflicting sentence.

main_pipeline.label: true
main_pipeline.reason: Hooks.md: payload may be changed to string, Buffer, stream, ReadableStream, Response or null. TypeScript.md: only string, Buffer, stream or null. lib/reply.js:183-188 accepts web streams (getReader) and Response.

main_pipeline.label: false
main_pipeline.reason: Migration guide sets useSemicolonDelimiter at the top level, Server.md under routerOptions. lib/route.js:696-711 (buildRouterOptions) falls back to the top-level key, so both placements work. Stylistic drift, not a factual conflict.

main_pipeline.label: false
main_pipeline.reason: Pairs the onRequest note (Hooks.md) with the preParsing note (TypeScript.md): two different hooks, so the two sentences do not contradict each other. The underlying TypeScript.md error is real but is already reported by findings 2 and 6.

main_pipeline.label: true
main_pipeline.reason: Hooks.md: in onRequest request.body is always undefined, because body parsing happens before preValidation. TypeScript.md: always null, because parsing happens before preHandler. lib/request.js:40 -> undefined; lib/handle-request.js runs parsing before preValidation.

main_pipeline.label: true
main_pipeline.reason: Server.md: GET, HEAD, TRACE, DELETE, OPTIONS, PATCH, PUT, POST and QUERY supported by default. TypeScript.md documents fastify.HTTPMethods as a 7-member union without TRACE/QUERY. types/utils.d.ts:17-18 has QUERY, TRACE and more.

main_pipeline.label: true
main_pipeline.reason: Same stale union in TypeScript.md, this time against the route options list in Routes.md. Same underlying defect as finding 7.

main_pipeline.label: false
main_pipeline.reason: Reference says the built-in default is 1m; the tutorial's example config sets 15s. An example that overrides a default is not a contradiction.

main_pipeline.label: false
main_pipeline.reason: Same as 9: `scrape_interval: 15s # By default, scrape targets every 15 seconds.` is the comment of an example config, not a statement about the built-in default.

main_pipeline.label: false
main_pipeline.reason: `hotUpdate` and `handleHotUpdate` are two different plugin hooks (the new per-environment hook and the older one). Reported as a name conflict; it is not.

main_pipeline.label: false
main_pipeline.reason: READMEs of two different packages. diff-sequences' default export takes lengths and callbacks; jest-diff's diff() takes values. Different functions.

main_pipeline.label: false
main_pipeline.reason: Same pair as 12 (import statements of two different packages).

main_pipeline.label: false
main_pipeline.reason: User option `indent` is a number (default 2); the normalised `config.indent` handed to plugins is a string. packages/pretty-format/src/types.ts:51 confirms Config.indent: string. Two different objects.

main_pipeline.label: true
main_pipeline.reason: entity-manager-api.md shows manager.update(User, [{criteria, data}, ...]) running three separate UPDATEs. repository-api.md (and lines 201-208 of the same file) say an array is a list of conditions OR'd into one UPDATE. packages/typeorm/src/entity-manager/EntityManager.ts:897-927 has only update(target, criteria, partialEntity, options) and no {criteria, data} form; nothing in src or test uses it.

main_pipeline.label: true
main_pipeline.reason: The same intro sentence says JavaScript (ES2023) in README.md and (ES2021) in getting-started.md. packages/typeorm/tsconfig.json extends @tsconfig/node20; tsconfig.browser.json uses lib es2023.

ablation_no_rerank_extra.label: true
ablation_no_rerank_extra.reason: Reply.md says the final payload must be string, Buffer, stream, undefined or null, otherwise an error is thrown. Hooks.md also allows ReadableStream and Response, and lib/reply.js:183-188 accepts them. The rerank run dropped the Reply.md passage, so the main pipeline missed this.

ablation_no_rerank_extra.label: uncertain
ablation_no_rerank_extra.reason: The two lists differ only in `undefined`; one is about the final payload, the other about what onSend may change it to. Both are stale against Hooks.md, but whether they contradict each other is arguable.

ablation_no_rerank_extra.label: false
ablation_no_rerank_extra.reason: Errors.md deliberately forwards expected errors with reply.send(error); Reply.md explains that this goes to the default error handler. Consistent.
